title: Malaysian Roti Bread
description: A simple recipe to make delicious roti bread at home, inspired by Malaysian cuisine.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine the all-purpose flour and chopped bread.
2. Gradually add water to the mixture to form a soft dough.
3. Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes until it becomes smooth.
4. Divide the dough into 6-8 equal portions.
5. Roll out each portion into a thin circle.
6. Heat a non-stick pan or griddle over medium heat.
7. Cook the roti for 1-2 minutes on each side, until it is golden brown.
8. Brush the roti with a little butter or ghee for extra flavor.
9. Repeat the process with the remaining dough portions.
10. Serve the roti bread hot with your favorite filling.
